# `interface_notice` — version 1.1

Source: `presets/interface-notice.satz`

## Purpose

Tells the teams whose HCL reads this estate's interface when an exported value
changes: one Pub/Sub message per apply that changes one.

The map asks how the teams hear of a change as a choice, `question oneof
interface_notice`, with one option per delivery form; Pub/Sub is the one satz has,
and this pack is it. A second form — a webhook, a push of the interface to a
customer repository — is a second option and a pack of its own beside this one.

The estate's exports (`export` statements, hcl/interfaces/) are what customer teams
read, in their own state and their own pipelines. This pack puts a notice behind
them, in four pieces in the infrastructure project:

1. a bucket that holds one object, `interface.json` — not the state bucket;
2. a Pub/Sub topic;
3. the grant that lets Cloud Storage's service agent publish to that topic;
4. a storage notification: every new generation of an object in the bucket
publishes one message to the topic.

The object is the estate's exported values as JSON (`interface`, `estate`, `core`, and
`interfaces` with one map per interface),
written from the root module's `local.satz_interface`, which satz emits beside the
outputs. Terraform rewrites the object only when its content changes, so an apply that
changes an exported value publishes one message and an apply that changes nothing
publishes none. The message names the object; the object holds the new values.

A team subscribes in its own state — its own `google_pubsub_subscription` on the topic,
a push to its CI's webhook or a pull from a runner. The topic and the object are
core exports of this pack (`interface_topic`, `interface_object`), so every interface
module and its README carry them, with the subscription to write.

The service agent's address carries the project's number, which only exists once the
project does, so the pack reads it with the provider's
`google_storage_project_service_account` data source, in a trusted `hcl` block: satz
writes no `data` source of its own. The notification names its topic through the grant,
so it is created after the grant, and the object records the notification's id, so it
is written after the notification and its first generation is published too.

NO CLAIM. No catalog control covers it.

## Use it

```
params {
  interface_notice_pubsub = true

  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  interface_notice_project = infra_project_name
  interface_notice_bucket_name = "{customer_shortname}-infra-001-interface"
  interface_notice_topic_name = "{customer_shortname}-satz-interface"
  interface_notice_location = default_region
}

use "presets/interface-notice.satz" when interface_notice_pubsub
```

`interface_notice_pubsub` is the gate: while it is falsy the pack contributes nothing — no resources, no params, no claims. It is declared by `estate_map`, and the estate's own binding wins.

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `customer_shortname` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `default_region` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `infra_project_name` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.

## Params

| param | default |
|---|---|
| `interface_notice_project` | `infra_project_name` |
| `interface_notice_bucket_name` | `"{customer_shortname}-infra-001-interface"` |
| `interface_notice_topic_name` | `"{customer_shortname}-satz-interface"` |
| `interface_notice_location` | `default_region` |

## Questions

What to ask before this pack is configured, and what changing the answer costs.

| asks about | prompt | reversal | blast | recommends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `interface_notice_project` | Which project holds the bucket and the topic the interface notice publishes through? | recreate | low | — |

**interface_notice_project** — Whoever may read the topic learns when the estate's exported values change and reads them from the object. The infrastructure project keeps it with the estate's other plumbing. Moving it later is a new topic, and every team's subscription has to be written again.


## Contributes

| resource type | labels |
|---|---|
| `google_pubsub_topic` | `interface_notice` |
| `google_pubsub_topic_iam_member` | `interface_notice_publisher` |
| `google_storage_bucket` | `interface_notice` |
| `google_storage_bucket_object` | `interface_notice` |
| `google_storage_notification` | `interface_notice` |

**Raw HCL:** 1 `hcl` block(s) — trusted: "the storage service agent's address carries the project number, which the provider's data source reads". Opaque to the compliance plane.

## Exports

Outputs of the root module and of `hcl/interfaces/` in every estate that uses this pack: a `core` export is an output of every interface module, another one of its interface's module alone.

| interface | output | value | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `core` | `interface_topic` | `"${google_pubsub_topic.interface_notice.id}"` | The topic that carries one message per apply that changes an exported value |
| `core` | `interface_object` | `"gs://{interface_notice_bucket_name}/interface.json"` | The object that holds the exported values as JSON |
